entry.title: Stakeholder Alignment: The Underrated Skill Every Product Manager Needs

Much of my work involves dealing with stakeholders at different levels and pursuing various objectives. AI will find it challenging to substitute that side of people interaction. I mean politics in a sense of power dynamics among multiple groups of stakeholders.
